policies.new_logprobs: standard continuation forward over re-tokenized response: outputs/task2_ppo/standard

mask_source: derived:ones(T); every response token is valid

cache_per_token_fields.note: old_logprobs/ref_logprobs/values are per-token (length T); response_tokens is an integer count asserted == T. Only new_logp is recomputed (standard forward).

retokenization.reason: cache stores response TEXT, not token IDs; the response is re-tokenized for the new_logp forward pass
retokenization.eos_alignment: cached per-token arrays include the terminal EOS; eos_token_id is appended to the re-tokenized ids iff terminated_with_eos is True
retokenization.assert: final (EOS-aligned) length == len(old_logprobs) per row; raises otherwise

alignment: per row: len(old_logp)==len(new_logp)==len(ref_logp)==len(values)==T=len(old_logprobs) enforced (raises on mismatch); ratio=exp(new-old)

advantage_reconstruction.route: gae(shaped_rewards(terminal, old_logp, ref_logp, mask, kl_beta), values); old_logp/ref_logp/values are cached per-token, new_logp is a standard-policy forward over the re-tokenized response
advantage_reconstruction.terminal_placement: last valid response index (mask.sum()-1) per shaped_rewards; the missing-EOS penalty is already folded into effective_terminal_reward, so clipped_at_max / terminated_with_eos do not move the deposit point.
